standard-dialogue.npc: Would you like to buy a nice kebab? Only one gold.

options.text: I think I'll give it a miss.

steps.player: I think I'll give it a miss.

steps.text: If the player has at least one coin:
a kebab and pays one coin
If the player has no coins:

steps.player: Oops, I forgot to bring any money with me.

steps.npc: Come back when you have some.

options.text: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?

steps.player: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?

steps.npc: I don't like him. He makes all these claims about being the best salesman in Gielinor, and he even has some thugs that he's hired to threaten us.
One of them came round here and threatened to cut my head off if I didn't cooperate with them!
I've also heard some rumours about them from my friend Ali in Pollnivneach...
Apparently he has men there as well, who have also been threatening people.
And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al Kharid himself!
That's what I've heard. Anyway, are you sure you wouldn't like a kebab?

treasure-trails-medium.npc: I've got a little problem for you to solve.

treasure-trails-medium-when-talked-to-ag.npc: Please enter the answer to the riddle.

steps.npc: No that's not right, think again.

steps.text: The salesman has given you another clue scroll!
